FileSystemManager.copyFile(Object object)

Copy files (Do not copy folders. The target path is a file. If the target file already exists, the copy will overwrite the existing target file.)(Minimum version: 23.6.0).

Parameter

Object object

Attribute Type Default Value Mandatory or Not Description
srcPath String Yes Source file path. (Local path. It can be a relative directory in the usr directory, but the final real path cannot be outside the usr directory. Files in temporary paths and cache paths can be copied)
destPath String Yes Destination path. (Local path, which can only be in the usr directory and can be a relative directory, but the final real path cannot be outside the usr directory.cannot be a temporary path or cache path)
success Function No Callback function that is successfully invoked.
fail Function No Callback function that fails to be invoked.
complete Function No Callback function used when an API call is complete. (This callback function is used whether the API call succeeds or fails.)

Sample Code

let fs = ma.getFileSystemManager();

fs.copyFile({
  srcPath: `${ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH}/resourceFile.txt`,
  destPath: `${ma.env.USER_DATA_PATH}/targetFile.txt`,
  success: (res) => {
    console.log(res);
  },
  fail: (err) => {
    console.log(err);
  }
});

Tips

  1. The maximum length of the copied new file name is 255 characters. If the file name is too long, the API fails to be invoked.
  2. The maximum size of a file is 10 MB.
